theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    simp_all
    refine ⟨rfl, InitStates.init_none, UpdateStates.update_none⟩
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    obtain ⟨σ₁, Hσ₁, Hinit₁, Hupd₁⟩ := ih Hinit
    refine ⟨Hσ₁.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
    . constructor <;> assumption
    . apply UpdateStates.update_some
      . simp [Hσ₁, UpdateStateUpdated Hup]
        rw [← updatedStateComm']
        . apply updatedStateUpdate
          apply InitStatesSomeMonotone
          simp_all
          apply updatedStatesInit
          omega
          apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone'
          assumption
          apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone'
          assumption
          assumption
          assumption
        . rw [List.unzip_zip] <;> norm_cast
          intro Hin
          have Hnd := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          simp_all
      . exact Hupd₁
